arxiv-1908-10866.title: Faint Rapid Red Transients from Neutron Star - CO White Dwarf Mergers 2019 Faint Rapid Red Transients from Neutron Star - CO White Dwarf Mergers – Appendix: Late-time fallback and fallback-powered lightcurve
arxiv-1908-10866.creator: Yossef Zenati, Alexey Bobrick, Hagai B. Perets
arxiv-1908-10866.description: Abstract Mergers of neutron stars (NS) and white dwarfs (WD) may give rise to observable explosive transient events. We use 3D hydrodynamical (SPH) simulations, as well as 2D hydrodynamical-thermonuclear simulations (using the FLASH AMR code) to model the disruption of CO-WDs by NSs, which produce faint transient events.

arxiv-2111-15413.title: Minor changes make a difference: a case study on the consistency of UD-based dependency parsers
arxiv-2111-15413.creator: Dmytro Kalpakchi, Johan Boye
arxiv-2111-15413.description: Abstract Many downstream applications are using dependency trees, and are thus relying on dependency parsers producing correct, or at least consistent, output. However, dependency parsers are trained using machine learning, and are therefore susceptible to unwanted inconsistencies due to biases in the training data.

arxiv-2202-12194.title: Towards a Heterogeneous Smart Electromagnetic Environment for Millimeter-Wave Communications: An Industrial Viewpoint
arxiv-2202-12194.creator: Roberto Flamini, Danilo De Donno, Jonathan Gambini, Francesco Giuppi, Christian Mazzucco, Angelo Milani, and Laura Resteghini
arxiv-2202-12194.description: Abstract Fifth generation (5G) and beyond communication systems open the door to millimeter Wave (mmWave) frequency bands to leverage the extremely large operating bandwidths and deliver unprecedented network capacity. These frequency bands are affected by high propagation losses that severely limit the achievable coverage.

arxiv-2506-21704.title: Crosstalk-Resilient Quantum MIMO for Scalable Quantum Communications Thanks: The authors are with the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability, and Trust (SnT), Luxembourg, L-1855 Luxembourg.
arxiv-2506-21704.creator: Seid Koudia, Symeon Chatzinotas
arxiv-2506-21704.description: Abstract We address the challenge of crosstalk in quantum multiplexing—an obstacle to scaling throughput in quantum communication networks. Crosstalk arises when physically coupled quantum modes interfere, degrading signal fidelity. We propose a mitigation strategy based on encoding discrete-variable (DV) quantum information into continuous-variable (CV) bosonic modes using Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) codes.

arxiv-2509-13863.title: LamiGauss: Pitching Radiative Gaussian for Sparse-View X-ray Laminography Reconstruction
arxiv-2509-13863.creator: Chu Chen, Ander Biguri, Jean-Michel Morel, Raymond H. Chan, Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb, and Jizhou Li
arxiv-2509-13863.description: Abstract X-ray Computed Laminography (CL) is essential for non-destructive inspection of plate-like structures in applications such as microchips and composite battery materials, where traditional computed tomography (CT) struggles due to geometric constraints. However, reconstructing high-quality volumes from laminographic projections remains challenging, particularly under highly sparse-view acquisition conditions.

pmc-10576986.title: Primary splenic multicystic peritoneal mesothelioma in a young healthy male
pmc-10576986.creator: Matthew D Price, Shuait Nair, James Harris
pmc-10576986.description: Multicystic peritoneal mesothelioma (BMPM) is a rare, usually benign tumor that arises from peritoneal mesothelial cells that most commonly occurs in women of reproductive age. Pathogenesis of these tumors is thought to come from chronic inflammation from prior surgery, endometriosis, trauma, or recurrent peritonitis.

pmc-11337573.title: Identification of circulating tumor cells captured by the FDA-cleared Parsortix® PC1 system from the peripheral blood of metastatic breast cancer patients using immunofluorescence and cytopathological evaluations
pmc-11337573.creator: Mariacristina Ciccioli, Kyukwang Kim, Negar Khazan, Joseph D Khoury, Martin J Cooke, M Craig Miller, Daniel J O’Shannessy, Anne-Sophie Pailhes-Jimenez, Richard G Moore
pmc-11337573.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Circulating Tumor Cells (CTCs) may serve as a non-invasive source of tumor material to investigate an individual’s disease in real-time. The Parsortix® PC1 System, the first FDA-cleared medical device for the capture and harvest of CTCs from peripheral blood of metastatic breast cancer (MBC) patients for use in subsequent user-validated downstream analyses, enables the epitope-independent capture of CTCs with diverse phenotypes based on cell size and deformability.

pmc-11497480.title: Synergistic combinations of novel polymyxins and rifampicin with improved eradication of colistin-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa biofilms
pmc-11497480.creator: Johan Storm Jørgensen, Anne Sofie Laulund Siebert, Oana Ciofu, Niels Høiby, Claus Moser, Henrik Franzyk
pmc-11497480.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundIncreased prevalence of antimicrobial resistance coupled with a lack of new antibiotics against Gram-negative bacteria emphasize the imperative for novel therapeutic strategies. Colistin-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa constitutes a challenge, where conventional treatment options lack efficacy, in particular for biofilm-associated infections.

pmc-11603331.title: Research on nonlinear dynamic vertical vibration characteristics and control of roll system in cold rolling mill
pmc-11603331.creator: Li Li, Chenhao Zhong
pmc-11603331.description: In order to address the vertical vibration phenomenon of the working roll during the rolling process, taking into consideration the nonlinear factors of the rolling interface and the roll system, this study establishes a nonlinear excitation vertical vibration model based on dynamic rolling force. The impact of nonlinear factors on system stability and vibration characteristics is analyzed.

pmc-11618793.title: Isolated sphenoid sinus fungal mucoceles: A rare entity with a high propensity for causing neurological complications
pmc-11618793.creator: Marwa Ibrahim, Marwan Alqunaee, Mustafa Najibullah, Zafdam Shabbir, Waleed A. Azab
pmc-11618793.description: Background: Isolated sphenoid sinus fungal mucoceles are extremely rare and potentially associated with visual disturbances, cranial nerve (CN) deficits, or pituitary dysfunction. Their initial symptoms are often absent or nonspecific, and routine examination offers little information, resulting in diagnostic and therapeutic delays.

pmc-11715524.title: Post‐COVID Cognitive impairment in a large hospital‐based multi‐ethnic sample during the COVID‐19 pandemic
pmc-11715524.creator: Reem M Neal, zhiyi Yang, Ihab Hajjar
pmc-11715524.description: BackgroundCOVID‐19 has been associated with developing cognitive impairment. Individuals with cognitive impairment have a higher likelihood of progressing into dementia. Furthermore, studies have suggested that COVID‐19 is associated with an increased risk of developing Alzheimer’s disease (HR 2.03). Despite the increasing number of individuals developing post‐COVID cognitive impairment, the risk factors remain unclear.

pmc-11716587.title: Utility of Plasma Biomarkers in Screening for Brain Amyloid in the 1Florida Alzheimer Disease Research Center (ADRC)
pmc-11716587.creator: Warren W Barker, Karen Velasquez, David A. Loewenstein, Rosie E Curiel, Melissa J Armstrong, Monica Rosselli, Malek Adjouadi, Breton M. Asken, David Vaillancourt, Jesse DeSimone, Glenn E. Smith, Michael Marsiske, Jacob Fiala, Darren M Weber, Jueun C Kim, Mileidys Herrera, Idaly Velez‐Uribe, Ranjan D
pmc-11716587.description: BackgroundWith the emergence of anti‐amyloid drugs, there is an increased need to determine the presence of brain amyloid in people using non‐invasive, cost‐effective biomarkers. The goal of this study was to determine the added and stand‐alone value of plasma biomarkers for predicting positive amyloid PET in a mixed sample of Hispanic and non‐Hispanic older adults.

pmc-12450385.title: Clinical Outcomes of Ilizarov Bone Transport for Distal Tibial Defects in Refractory Osteomyelitis: A Retrospective Study
pmc-12450385.creator: Abudusalamu Alimujiang, Qiyu Jia, Jian Guo, Jun Zhang, Xi Wang, Meng Zhao, Meidege Ouzhabayier, Yingbo Wang, Chuang Ma
pmc-12450385.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDistal tibial defects following refractory osteomyelitis pose a significant orthopedic challenge, necessitating effective reconstruction. The Ilizarov bone transport technique is a potential treatment option, but its clinical outcomes specifically for distal tibial infectious defects need further evaluation.MethodsIn this retrospective observational single-arm study, we analyzed the clinical data of 22 patients who had undergone multiple debridements for refractory distal tibial osteomyelitis (DTO) and had associated bone defects, and were subsequently treated with the Ilizarov bone transport technique.

pmc-12628289.title: Involving Carers in Therapy for Adults With Intellectual Disabilities: A Systematic Review of Client, Carer and Therapist Perspectives
pmc-12628289.creator: Charlotte Farnsworth, Thomas Schröder
pmc-12628289.description: BackgroundAdaptations are frequently reported when delivering therapy to people with an intellectual disability, including the involvement of carers. This review aimed to understand the experience of carer involvement from the perspective of the person, therapist and caregiver.MethodsA systematic search of six databases and of reference lists was conducted.

pmc-13146054.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1072 INTRAVENOUS THROMBOLYSIS BEFORE ENDOVASCULAR THROMBECTOMY IN DISTAL MEDIUM VESSEL OCCLUSION: ANALYSIS FROM THE IRETAS REGISTRY
pmc-13146054.creator: Antonio Ciacciarelli, Ettore Nicolini, Valentina Saia, Giovanni Pracucci, Maria Ruggiero, Luigi Simonetti, Francesca Rosini, Stefano Vallone, Salvatore Mangiafico, Danilo Toni
pmc-13146054.description: Background and aimsThe optimal acute treatment for distal medium vessel occlusions (DMVOs) remains uncertain. We evaluated the effectiveness and safety of intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) plus endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) versus EVT alone in patients with DMVOs.MethodsPatients with DMVOs were identified from the Italian Registry of Endovascular Treatment in Acute Stroke (IRETAS). Patients were classified as EVT alone or IVT + EVT.

pmc-13415291.title: OsBph32 Contributes to Coordinated Cell Wall and Metabolic Responses in Rice Resistance to Brown Planthopper
pmc-13415291.creator: Lulu Wang, Ting Liang, Aoyun Zhu, Juansheng Ren, Fangyuan Gao, Guangjun Ren, Renshan Zhu, Xianting Wu
pmc-13415291.description: The brown planthopper (BPH, Nilaparvata lugens) is a major insect pest of rice (Oryza sativa L.) causing severe yield losses across Asia. Although the resistance gene OsBph32 from the cultivar Ptb33 enhances BPH resistance, its molecular and physiological mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we investigated its function using OsBph32-overexpressing lines combined with physiological, transcriptomic, and metabolomic analyses.

pmc-13461119.title: Alcohol Interaction and ALDH2: Missing Links in EMPHASIS
pmc-13461119.creator: Koichiro Yuji, Wakako Yuji

pmc-13499138.title: The shifting global thalassemia burden and lessons from Chineseintegrated control strategy
pmc-13499138.creator: Cheng Jin, Zhilin Hu, Yue Li, Qihong Lin, Jiaming Yu, Qian Zhang, Mingjing Luo, Chunlan Yang, Xiaohui Zhou, Feiqiu Wen, Wenyi Jin, Sixi Liu
pmc-13499138.description: SummaryThalassemias impose a substantial but highly uneven global health burden. Using Global Burden of Disease 2023 estimates, we quantified the prevalence, mortality, and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) of thalassemias across 204 countries and territories from 1980 to 2023 and evaluated health system performance with frontier analysis.
